systems.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system
systems.tiers: named only as a system the social registry is integrated with

systems.system: Imibereho Dynamic Social Registry integration with CRVS
systems.tiers: national; launched 29 February 2024; a birth registered in CRVS updates the social registry automatically; also cross-checked against NIDA, LODA's MEIS and HMIS

note: A social registry launch: the civil registration system appears only as a source that updates it, with nothing on where or how a birth is registered.
